summary: VolitionRx filed an 8-K reporting that on September 11, 2026 it prepaid in cash the remaining ~$422,000 principal on its $7.5M senior secured convertible note originally issued May 20, 2025 to Lind Global Asset Management XII LLC, satisfying all obligations under that note. The separate $2.4M January 2026 note to Lind remains outstanding. Management framed the prepayment as reducing equity overhang. No price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. What to watch: the residual 2026 note conversion terms and cash position remain the key overhang considerations.
